summary.event_logic: breakout 20-bar + range >=1.5 prior ATR + body >=60% + extreme close >=75%; first close-based pullback 0.35-1.5ATR in six bars without reentry or new impulse extreme; no fitted filters
summary.cautions: Descriptive lookalike audit, not source-native P01/P04/P05/P06/P07/P10 strategy parity; fixed-time exit diagnostics are not executed TP, the wick boundary is not a validated stop, 0.1/0.2/0.4% roundtrip friction is hypothetical and excludes funding/slippage/mark-price execution. Historical events overlap; no de-duplication. Different TF periods and small OOS samples limit conclusions. Comparator alt selection is exploratory and may have survivorship bias.
